description: Checks whether a text (50-2,000 words) looks AI-written, for example by ChatGPT, Gemini or Claude. Languages: English, Ukrainian, Kazakh, Uzbek, Estonian, Georgian, Lithuanian. Each language other than English is checked by our own detector trained on that language. Returns an AI likelihood for the whole text and for each part. Detectors make mistakes; never present the result as proof. Text is not stored.

text.description: Text to check, 50-2,000 words, in one of: English, Ukrainian, Kazakh, Uzbek, Estonian, Georgian, Lithuanian

name: check_ai_text
title: Check if text is AI-written
